title: TLS handover checklist: cert, chain, cron, four hidden traps
lede: A one-page TLS handover checklist for inherited sites. The leaf, the chain, the cron and the four hidden traps hosts forget to mention at handover.
hero_alt: Overhead still life on bone linen: TLS handover checklist on graph paper, paper certificates, brass key, fountain pen, red wax seal.
